method: Each figure was searched for its original source. Full pages could not be opened from the research environment, so checks rely on search-result summaries of the cited pages.

items.claim: 28% of open-world survival-craft Steam games reach 1,000 reviews (Steam Page Analyzer)
items.verifiedValue: 28.3% of 138 games released Jan 1 2024–Jun 30 2025 (vs 4.2% all Steam; 6.7x)
items.note: Cohort window matters. 90 OWSC releases in 2025 and 92 in 2024; 2026 YTD +39% on the same weeks.

items.claim: 11% of Cozy-tagged Steam games reach 1,000 reviews vs 4.2% of all Steam games
items.verifiedValue: 11% of 661 Cozy games released Jan 2024–Jun 2025 vs 4.2% all Steam (2.6x)
items.note: 1,000 reviews is treated as roughly $150k gross by rule of thumb. Measured Sept 27 2026.
A further 2,730 unreleased Cozy pages exist, 333 dated within 90 days.

items.claim: Cozy games priced $20+ reach 1,000 reviews 45.2% vs 2.7% under $5; city builders $20+ 46.5%
items.note: Price correlates with production scope; this is not proof that raising the price causes success.

items.verifiedValue: Steam tag 'Shop Keeper' (not 'shop sim'): 477 releases Jan 1–Sep 27 2026 vs 65 in the same weeks of 2025 (+634%). 'Idler' +150%. Automation +170%, Cozy +143%; all Steam +45%.
items.note: Numbers match. Relabel as 'Shop Keeper tag' and note it compares the same weeks (YTD), not full years.

items.verifiedValue: Estimates range from about 1.0M to 2.1M: Gamalytic ~1.04M, SteamSpy ~1.44M, VG Insights ~1.60M, PlayTracker ~2.06M
items.note: No official figure. 1.3M sits inside the range but matches no single tool; show it as a range or cite one tool.

items.claim: Tiny Glade 616k copies in under a month and 1.3M wishlists at launch
items.verifiedValue: 616,528 copies about one month after the Sept 23 2024 launch; about 1.3M wishlists around launch (later 1.9M+)

items.claim: Rusty's Retirement: 26% of sales from China; 500k+ copies
items.verifiedValue: China 26% of sales (Japan 10%, Korea 6%, Taiwan 4%); 500k copies (dev, Feb 2025), about 550k by July 2025; 100k in the first ~5 days
items.note: Regional split comes from a Wikipedia summary of developer data; the original primary source was not seen.

items.claim: Wishlist-to-first-week conversion 0.15x median; 0.10x for games over $10
items.verifiedValue: Median 0.15x for games with 25k+ wishlists at launch; 0.10x for titles priced above $10; about 0.14x excluding NSFW
items.note: The sample is games with more than 25k wishlists only, so it should not be applied to small launches without that caveat. Spread is an order of magnitude.

items.claim: Next Fest: little lift below ~2,000 pre-fest wishlists
items.verifiedValue: Games need about 2,000+ pre-fest wishlists for algorithmic lift. Data from 208 games (Feb 2025): <1k invisible after day 2, 1–2k modest gains, 2k+ momentum possible. Spearman r = 0.825 between pre-fest and in-fest wishlists.
items.note: Chris Zukowski (How To Market A Game) benchmarks.

items.verifiedValue: 50M+ copies, announced by ConcernedApe at the 10th anniversary (Feb 2026); VGChartz logs 50M as of Feb 26 2026 (41M+ in Dec 2024)

items.claim: 'Cozy' in short descriptions of $100k+ Steam games: 0.4% (2022) to 3.1% (2025)
items.note: GameDiscoverCo keyword study (top 1,000 keywords in short descriptions), reported Feb 2026.

items.claim: Grow a Garden peak ~22M concurrent players
items.verifiedValue: 21.6M concurrent (late June 2025, per Roblox via AP), beating Fortnite's 15.2M
items.note: Display as 21.6M. One outlier report of 47M (Aug 2025) was not corroborated and should not be used.

items.claim: 52.4M US gamers aged 50+, 73% play puzzle games (AARP)
items.verifiedValue: 52.4M confirmed (AARP 2023 study, 2022 data; 45% of 50+). The 73% figure was not found for puzzle games: AARP's 2019 data says 73% played on smartphones/tablets. 2023: 80%+ play on mobile; puzzle, card and word games are the top genres.
items.note: Drop or replace '73% play puzzle games'; it appears to be a misattributed device statistic.

items.verifiedValue: Median gross about $70k (median 5–7k copies) for 'X Simulator' games released since July 2023
items.note: Simon Carless / GameDiscoverCo, mid-2024. Supermarket Simulator was the top title ($22.2M at the time).
